# Document + Section class hierarchy

class Section:
    section_type: str = "other"

    def __init__(self, doc: "Document", key: str, position: int,
                 heading: str | None, body: str,
                 layer_code: str | None, branch_code: str | None):
        self.doc = doc
        self.conn = doc.conn
        self.key = key
        self.position = position
        self.heading = heading
        self.body = body
        self.layer_code = layer_code
        self.branch_code = branch_code

    def get_body(self) -> str:
        return self.body

    def set_body(self, body: str):
        self.body = body
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE sections SET body=? WHERE key=?",
                          (body, self.key))

    def set_heading(self, heading: str):
        self.heading = heading
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE sections SET heading=? WHERE key=?",
                          (heading, self.key))

    def render(self) -> str:
        body = self._render_body()
        if self.section_type == "doc_top":
            return body
        prefix = "###" if self.section_type in ("branch", "subbranch") else "##"
        return f"\n\n{prefix} {self.heading}\n\n{body}"

    def _render_body(self) -> str:
        return self.body


class DocTop(Section):       section_type = "doc_top"
class MainOverview(Section): section_type = "main_overview"
class BranchIntro(Section):  section_type = "branch_intro"
class Branch(Section):       section_type = "branch"
class Crosscut(Section):     section_type = "crosscut"
class Other(Section):        section_type = "other"


class _LayerLike(Section):
    """Layer / SubBranch: body is markdown, but offers entry-level methods
    that locate by slug and patch body via stable [[N]](url) tokens."""

    # --- entry mutations (operate on section.body) ----------------------

    def _entry_or_die(self, slug: str) -> Entry:
        e = load_entry(self.conn, slug=slug)
        if not e:
            raise KeyError(f"entry slug='{slug}' not found")
        if e.section_key != self.key:
            raise ValueError(
                f"entry '{slug}' belongs to section '{e.section_key}', "
                f"not '{self.key}'")
        return e

    def _patch_body_unique(self, old: str, new: str):
        count = self.body.count(old)
        if count == 0:
            raise ValueError(
                f"internal: token {old!r} not found in section '{self.key}'. "
                f"index out of sync — run `refresh-index`.")
        if count > 1:
            raise ValueError(
                f"internal: token {old!r} appears {count} times in "
                f"section '{self.key}' — ambiguous patch.")
        self.set_body(self.body.replace(old, new, 1))

    def set_entry_url(self, slug: str, url: str):
        e = self._entry_or_die(slug)
        if not e.ref_nums:
            raise ValueError(f"entry '{slug}' has no refs — can't locate token")
        n = e.ref_nums[0]
        old_tok = f"[[{n}]]({e.url})"
        new_tok = f"[[{n}]]({url})"
        # apply to ALL occurrences of this exact (N, url) token (some entries
        # appear in multiple cells; for layer/sub body it's typically 1 hit)
        if old_tok not in self.body:
            raise ValueError(
                f"entry '{slug}' token {old_tok!r} not in body — "
                f"run refresh-index.")
        self.set_body(self.body.replace(old_tok, new_tok))
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET url=? WHERE id=?", (url, e.id))

    def set_entry_name(self, slug: str, name: str):
        e = self._entry_or_die(slug)
        if not e.ref_nums:
            raise ValueError(f"entry '{slug}' has no refs")
        n = e.ref_nums[0]
        # token in body: <name>[[N]](url) — match name + immediate `[[N]]`
        old_pat = re.compile(
            r"(?P<name>[^\s|，,、；;（(\[\]]+(?:\s[^\s|，,、；;（(\[\]]+)*)"
            + re.escape(f"[[{n}]]"))
        # we expect exactly one match where group('name') equals e.name (after
        # stripping bold wrap). Find candidates whose name token == e.name.
        target = None
        for m in old_pat.finditer(self.body):
            cand = m.group("name").lstrip("*").rstrip("*").strip()
            if cand == e.name or cand.endswith(e.name):
                target = m; break
        if not target:
            raise ValueError(
                f"could not locate name token for entry '{slug}'. "
                f"Use `section set-body` to edit manually.")
        old_full = target.group(0)
        # preserve bold wrap if present
        prefix = ""
        suffix = ""
        body_name = target.group("name")
        if body_name.startswith("**") and body_name.endswith("**"):
            prefix = "**"; suffix = "**"
            inner = body_name[2:-2]
            old_full = f"{prefix}{inner}[[{n}]]"
            new_full = f"{prefix}{name}{suffix}[[{n}]]"
        else:
            new_full = old_full.replace(e.name, name, 1)
        self._patch_body_unique(old_full, new_full)
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET name=? WHERE id=?", (name, e.id))

    def set_entry_notes(self, slug: str, notes: str | None):
        e = self._entry_or_die(slug)
        if not e.ref_nums:
            raise ValueError(f"entry '{slug}' has no refs")
        n = e.ref_nums[0]
        anchor = f"[[{n}]]({e.url})" if e.url else f"[[{n}]]"
        idx = self.body.find(anchor)
        if idx < 0:
            raise ValueError(f"anchor {anchor!r} not in body")
        end = idx + len(anchor)
        tail = self.body[end:]
        # Existing parenthetical immediately after?
        m_open = re.match(r"^\s*[（(]", tail)
        if m_open:
            # find matching close
            opener = tail.lstrip()[0]
            closer = "）" if opener == "（" else ")"
            depth = 0; close_idx = None
            scan_start = end + (len(tail) - len(tail.lstrip()))
            for i in range(scan_start, len(self.body)):
                ch = self.body[i]
                if ch == opener:
                    depth += 1
                elif ch == closer:
                    depth -= 1
                    if depth == 0:
                        close_idx = i; break
            if close_idx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"unbalanced parens after {anchor}")
            old_segment = self.body[end:close_idx + 1]
            new_segment = f"（{notes}）" if notes else ""
            self.set_body(self.body[:end] + new_segment +
                          self.body[close_idx + 1:])
        else:
            if not notes:
                pass  # nothing to remove
            else:
                self.set_body(self.body[:end] + f"（{notes}）" + self.body[end:])
        self.conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET notes=? WHERE id=?",
                          (notes, e.id))

    def add_entry(self, vb_label: str | None, name: str, url: str,
                  ref_num: int, notes: str | None = None,
                  separator: str | None = None) -> Entry:
        """Insert a new entry into the body under the given vendor-block
        label. Layout (bullets vs inline) is auto-detected. Returns the
        freshly-indexed Entry."""
        # render the new token
        note_part = f"（{notes}）" if notes else ""
        tok = f"{name}[[{ref_num}]]({url}){note_part}"

        if vb_label is None:
            # append as new bullet at end of body
            new_body = self.body.rstrip() + f"\n- {tok}"
        else:
            new_body = self._insert_in_vendor_block(vb_label, tok, separator)
        self.set_body(new_body)
        # update derived index for just this section
        refresh_section_index(self.conn, self.key)
        # locate the new entry
        slug = slugify(self.layer_code or self.branch_code or self.key, name)
        e = load_entry(self.conn, slug=slug)
        if e is None:
            # slug may have collided; pick most recent matching name in section
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT slug FROM entries WHERE section_key=? AND name=? "
                "ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1", (self.key, name)
            ).fetchone()
            if row:
                e = load_entry(self.conn, slug=row[0])
        return e

    def remove_entry(self, slug: str):
        e = self._entry_or_die(slug)
        if not e.ref_nums:
            raise ValueError(f"entry '{slug}' has no refs")
        n = e.ref_nums[0]
        anchor = f"[[{n}]]({e.url})" if e.url else f"[[{n}]]"
        # find the line containing the anchor
        lines = self.body.split("\n")
        target_idx = None
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            if anchor in ln:
                target_idx = i; break
        if target_idx is None:
            raise ValueError(f"could not locate entry '{slug}' for removal")
        line = lines[target_idx]
        if line.lstrip().startswith(("-", "*")) and line.count("[[") == 1:
            # whole bullet is this single entry → drop the line
            del lines[target_idx]
        else:
            # remove just this entry token + adjacent separator
            new_line = _remove_entry_token(line, e.name, n, e.url, e.notes)
            lines[target_idx] = new_line
        self.set_body("\n".join(lines))
        # delete from index
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM entries WHERE id=?", (e.id,))

    # --- internal: insert into vendor block -----------------------------

    def _insert_in_vendor_block(self, vb_label: str, tok: str,
                                separator: str | None) -> str:
        """Locate `**vb_label**：` header in body and append tok. Layout is
        auto-detected: bullets vs inline."""
        # standalone header: `**LBL**：\n - ...` (bullets)
        header_full = f"**{vb_label}**："
        # try halfwidth colon too
        header_alt = f"**{vb_label}**:"
        lines = self.body.split("\n")
        # find header line
        header_idx = None
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            s = ln.strip()
            if s == header_full or s == header_alt:
                header_idx = i; break
            # inline form: header at start of line
            if s.startswith(header_full) or s.startswith(header_alt):
                header_idx = i; break
        if header_idx is None:
            raise KeyError(
                f"vendor-block label '{vb_label}' not found in section "
                f"'{self.key}'. Edit body manually via `section set-body`.")

        header_line = lines[header_idx]
        s = header_line.strip()
        if s == header_full or s == header_alt:
            # bullets layout — find last bullet line in this group
            end = header_idx + 1
            while end < len(lines) and lines[end].lstrip().startswith(("-", "*")):
                end += 1
            insert_at = end
            indent = "- "
            lines.insert(insert_at, f"{indent}{tok}")
            return "\n".join(lines)
        # inline layout — append to header line
        sep = separator or _infer_inline_separator(header_line)
        lines[header_idx] = header_line.rstrip() + sep + tok
        return "\n".join(lines)


def _infer_inline_separator(line: str) -> str:
    # try to detect from existing entry separators
    if "、" in line:
        return "、"
    if " + " in line:
        return " + "
    if ", " in line:
        return ", "
    return "、"


def _remove_entry_token(line: str, name: str, ref_num: int,
                        url: str | None, notes: str | None) -> str:
    """Strip the entry token + an adjoining separator from a single line."""
    note_part = f"（{notes}）" if notes else ""
    suffix = f"[[{ref_num}]]" + (f"({url})" if url else "") + note_part
    # build target substring: name + suffix
    target = name + suffix
    idx = line.find(target)
    if idx < 0:
        # try without notes (notes may have escaped chars)
        target = name + f"[[{ref_num}]]" + (f"({url})" if url else "")
        idx = line.find(target)
        if idx < 0:
            return line  # silent no-op; caller can refresh-index
    # absorb adjoining separator on left (preferred) or right
    seps = ["、", " + ", ", ", "；", "; "]
    before = line[:idx]; after = line[idx + len(target):]
    for sep in seps:
        if before.endswith(sep):
            before = before[:-len(sep)]; break
        if after.startswith(sep):
            after = after[len(sep):]; break
    return before + after


class Layer(_LayerLike):    section_type = "layer"
class SubBranch(_LayerLike): section_type = "subbranch"


class SummaryTable(Section):
    section_type = "summary_table"

    def get_intro(self) -> str:
        """The prose paragraph before the markdown table."""
        for i, line in enumerate(self.body.split("\n")):
            if line.startswith("|"):
                return "\n".join(self.body.split("\n")[:i]).rstrip()
        return self.body.rstrip()

    def set_intro(self, text: str):
        lines = self.body.split("\n")
        table_start = None
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            if line.startswith("|"):
                table_start = i; break
        new_body = text.rstrip() + ("\n\n" + "\n".join(lines[table_start:])
                                    if table_start is not None else "")
        self.set_body(new_body)

    def get_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str) -> str | None:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT text FROM cells WHERE layer_code=? AND branch_code=?",
            (layer_code, branch_code)
        ).fetchone()
        return row[0] if row else None

    def set_cell(self, layer_code: str, branch_code: str, text: str | None):
        marker = classify_cell_marker(text or "")
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cells(layer_code, branch_code, text, marker) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (layer_code, branch_code, text, marker),
        )
        # rebuild body so render is byte-faithful even if we never re-render
        self._rebuild_table_body()

    def _rebuild_table_body(self):
        """Rebuild the markdown table from cells. Preserve any prose
        before / after the table (intro / outro) from the current body."""
        lines = self.body.split("\n")
        first_tbl = last_tbl = None
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            if ln.startswith("|"):
                if first_tbl is None:
                    first_tbl = i
                last_tbl = i
        intro = "\n".join(lines[:first_tbl]).rstrip() if first_tbl else ""
        outro = "\n".join(lines[last_tbl + 1:]) if last_tbl is not None else ""

        header = "| L | " + " | ".join(f"{c}. {n}" for c, n in MAIN_BRANCHES) + " |"
        sep = "|---|" + "---|" * len(MAIN_BRANCHES)
        rows = [header, sep]
        layers = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT code, name FROM layers ORDER BY position"
        ).fetchall()
        for code, name in layers:
            cells = {b: "" for b, _ in MAIN_BRANCHES}
            for br, txt in self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT branch_code, text FROM cells WHERE layer_code=?",
                (code,),
            ).fetchall():
                cells[br] = txt or ""
            row_cells = " | ".join(cells[b] for b, _ in MAIN_BRANCHES)
            rows.append(f"| {code} {name} | {row_cells} |")
        new_body = intro + "\n\n" + "\n".join(rows)
        # outro starts at lines[last_tbl+1] — the "\n" between the table row
        # and lines[last_tbl+1] is implicit, so we always add it back here
        if outro:
            new_body += "\n" + outro
        self.set_body(new_body)


class Refs(Section):
    section_type = "refs"

    def next_num(self) -> int:
        row = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(num), 0) FROM refs"
        ).fetchone()
        return row[0] + 1

    def add(self, citation: str, url: str | None = None) -> int:
        # Strip the trailing "[Online]. Available: <...>" if user pasted a
        # full IEEE-style citation AND also supplied --url; Ref.render adds
        # this suffix from the url field on its own.
        citation = re.sub(
            r"\s*\[Online\]\.\s+Available:\s*<[^>]+>\s*$", "", citation
        ).strip()
        if url:
            row = self.conn.execute(
                "SELECT num FROM refs WHERE url=?", (url,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row:
                return row[0]
        num = self.next_num()
        self.conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO refs(num, citation, url) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (num, citation, url),
        )
        self._rebuild_body()
        return num

    def get(self, num: int) -> Ref | None:
        return load_ref(self.conn, num)

    def set(self, num: int, citation: str | None = None, url: str | None = None):
        fields, vals = [], []
        if citation is not None:
            citation = re.sub(
                r"\s*\[Online\]\.\s+Available:\s*<[^>]+>\s*$", "", citation
            ).strip()
            fields.append("citation=?"); vals.append(citation)
        if url is not None:
            fields.append("url=?"); vals.append(url)
        if fields:
            vals.append(num)
            self.conn.execute(
                f"UPDATE refs SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE num=?", vals)
            self._rebuild_body()

    def remove(self, num: int):
        self.conn.execute("DELETE FROM refs WHERE num=?", (num,))
        self._rebuild_body()

    def _rebuild_body(self):
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs ORDER BY num"
        ).fetchall()
        rendered = "\n\n".join(
            Ref(num=r[0], citation=r[1], url=r[2]).render() for r in rows
        )
        self.set_body(rendered)


SECTION_CLASSES = {
    "doc_top": DocTop,
    "summary_table": SummaryTable,
    "main_overview": MainOverview,
    "layer": Layer,
    "branch_intro": BranchIntro,
    "branch": Branch,
    "subbranch": SubBranch,
    "crosscut": Crosscut,
    "refs": Refs,
    "other": Other,
}


class Document:
    def __init__(self, conn: sqlite3.Connection):
        self.conn = conn

    def section(self, key: str) -> Section:
        row = get_section_row(self.conn, key)
        if not row:
            raise KeyError(f"section '{key}' not found")
        return self._instantiate(row)

    def sections(self) -> Iterable[Section]:
        rows = self.conn.execute(
            "SELECT key, position, section_type, heading, body, layer_code, "
            "branch_code FROM sections ORDER BY position"
        ).fetchall()
        for row in rows:
            yield self._instantiate(row)

    def _instantiate(self, row) -> Section:
        key, position, stype, heading, body, lc, bc = row
        cls = SECTION_CLASSES.get(stype, Other)
        return cls(self, key=key, position=position, heading=heading,
                   body=body or "", layer_code=lc, branch_code=bc)

    def entry(self, slug: str) -> Entry | None:
        return load_entry(self.conn, slug=slug)

    def ref(self, num: int) -> Ref | None:
        return load_ref(self.conn, num)

    def render(self) -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        for s in self.sections():
            out.append(s.render())
        return "".join(out).rstrip() + "\n"

    def commit(self):
        self.conn.commit()


def refresh_section_index(conn: sqlite3.Connection, section_key: str):
    """Rebuild entries for a single section after a body mutation."""
    row = get_section_row(conn, section_key)
    if not row:
        return
    _, _, stype, _, body, lc, bc = row
    if stype not in LAYER_LIKE_TYPES:
        return
    # delete this section's entries (cascade drops entry_refs)
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM entries WHERE section_key=?", (section_key,))
    # rebuild slug_seen by collecting globally-existing slugs
    slug_seen = {r[0] for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT slug FROM entries").fetchall()}
    index_section_body(conn, section_key, stype, body, lc, bc, slug_seen)

# migration from legacy `blocks` table

def migrate_from_blocks(conn: sqlite3.Connection):
    cur = conn.cursor()
    has_blocks = cur.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='blocks'"
    ).fetchone()
    if not has_blocks:
        sys.exit("legacy `blocks` table not found — nothing to migrate.")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
    # wipe new tables
    cur.executescript("""
        DELETE FROM entry_refs;
        DELETE FROM entries;
        DELETE FROM cells;
        DELETE FROM refs;
        DELETE FROM layers;
        DELETE FROM branches;
        DELETE FROM sections;
    """)
    rows = cur.execute(
        "SELECT key, order_idx, block_type, title, body, layer_code, "
        "branch_code FROM blocks ORDER BY order_idx"
    ).fetchall()
    for key, order_idx, btype, title, body, lc, bc in rows:
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO sections(key, position, section_type, heading, "
            "body, layer_code, branch_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (key, order_idx, btype, title, body or "", lc, bc),
        )
    refresh_all_indexes(conn)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# db lifecycle

def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        sys.exit(f"db not found: {DB_PATH}; run `init`.")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


def init_db() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    conn.commit()
    return conn

# CLI

    init_db()

def cmd_migrate(args):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
    # drop any leftover v1/v2 tables
    conn.executescript("""
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS section_parts;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS vendor_blocks;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS entry_refs;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS entries;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS refs;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS cells;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS branch_cells;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS layers;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS branches;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sections;
        DROP TABLE IF EXISTS sync_meta;
    """)
    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)
    migrate_from_blocks(conn)
    for table in ("sections", "entries", "entry_refs", "refs", "cells",
                  "layers", "branches"):
        n = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
        print(f"  {table:14s} {n}")
    conn.close()

- **L13 推理引擎 与 L14 模型服务 的边界正在合并**：vLLM、SGLang[[109]](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) 自带 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP server，挤压了纯 L14 厂商（KServe、BentoML）的独立性。

- **L18 LLM 应用框架 在 2025 出现 "去 LangChain[[153]](https://www.langchain.com/) 化"信号**：原生 SDK（OpenAI Agents SDK、Claude Agent SDK）抢占了 LangChain 早期的功能位；LangChain 通过 LangGraph + LangSmith 上移到 L24 + L28。

content.subject: 设计新数据模型 + 模板架构
content.description: 规划：sqlite3 保留 layers/branches/refs/cells/entries（+ 新增 entry_groups 表表达 vendor block 分组与 layout），所有散文（每层 intro、branch overview、crosscut、preamble 等）移到 chat/AISW-stack/templates/*.j2 文件中。一个主 readme.md.j2 + 几个 partial + macros。

content.subject: 实现新 schema + entry_groups 表
content.description: 扩展 sqlite3 schema：新增 entry_groups(id, section_key, position, label, vendor, layout, separator)；entries 表新增 group_id 列，group_id 替代 layer/branch + vendor 的隐式分组。

content.subject: 写迁移脚本：从 sections.body 抽出 groups + entries 到结构表，把散文写入模板文件
content.description: 一次性脚本：(1) 解析每个 layer/subbranch 的 body，识别 vendor block / category block / inline list，生成 entry_groups 行并把 entries 关联到 group_id；(2) 抽出每个 section 的纯散文（intro/outro/branch overview/crosscut/top/main-overview/parallel-intro）写入对应 templates/*.j2 文件。

content.subject: 实现 Jinja2 渲染器替换 render()
content.description: 改 render 命令：用 jinja2.Environment 加载 templates/readme.md.j2，传入 layers/branches/entries/groups/refs/cells 数据，输出 README.md。增加 _macros.j2（render_entry, render_group, render_summary_table, render_refs 等）。

content.subject: 改 Controller CLI：删 section set-body，加 group CRUD，调整 entry add
content.description: entry set-url/name/notes 直接改 entries 表行（不再 body patch）；entry add 接受 --group-id 或 --vb-label（解析到 group_id）；新增 group add/remove/set-label/set-layout；section set-body 退役（散文改模板文件）；refresh-index 退役或改为只重建 derived metadata。

content.subject: 字节级验证 + 更新 SKILL.md
content.description: 新 render 跑出的 README.md 应与原 README.md 字节级 / 接近字节级一致（可接受表头空格规整化等表面差异）。最后大改 SKILL.md：删 body 相关流程，加模板编辑流程 + 新 group/entry CLI 配方。

input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""AISW-stack MVC Controller —— Jinja2 视图版本。

架构：
  Model       chat/AISW-stack/index.sqlite3
                结构化数据 (source of truth)：
                  layers       (code, position, name)
                  branches     (code, parent_code, position, name)
                  entries      (slug, name, url, notes, ref_num, vendor,
                                section_key, group_position,
                                group_label_display, group_layout,
                                group_separator, bullet_position,
                                bullet_sub_label, position)
                  refs         (num, citation, url)
                  cells        (layer_code, branch_code, text)
                  prose_blocks (section_key, kind, body) — staging only
  Template    chat/AISW-stack/templates/
                readme.md.j2    主模版
                _macros.j2      渲染宏（entry / group / summary table / refs）
                prose/<key>.md  每个 section 的散文（用户手工编辑这些文件改散文）
  Controller  scripts/aiswstack_controller.py（本文件）
                render() = Jinja2 加载模板 → 注入 db 数据 → 写 README.md

## CLI

  init                          建空 schema（重置 db）
  render                        Jinja2 渲染 → 写 README.md
  stats
  query SQL                     只读 SELECT

  entry list [--owner CODE] [--vendor V] [--group GPOS]
  entry show SLUG
  entry add OWNER --name N --url U --ref R --group-label LBL
            [--layout bullets|inline] [--separator SEP] [--notes T]
            [--bullet-sub-label SL]
  entry set-url SLUG --url U
  entry set-name SLUG --name N
  entry set-notes SLUG --notes T
  entry remove SLUG

  group list [--owner CODE]
  group set-label OWNER --gpos N --label LBL
  group set-layout OWNER --gpos N --layout L [--separator SEP]
  group renumber OWNER          压缩 group_position 间隙

  ref list [--orphan]
  ref show NUM
  ref add --citation T [--url U]
  ref set NUM [--citation T] [--url U]
  ref remove NUM
  ref next-num

  cell get LAYER BRANCH
  cell set LAYER BRANCH --text T

## 设计要点

1. 模型只存数据。每条 entry 行带其分组与排版元数据（denormalized），
   render 时按 (section_key, group_position) 聚合、按 bullet_position 切分。
2. 散文（每层 intro / 分支 overview / crosscut / preamble）作为 Jinja2 文件
   存在 templates/prose/，用户直接编辑这些 .md 文件。
3. render 只读数据 + 模板，不写库；mutation 命令只写库，不写模板。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DB_PATH = ROOT / "chat/AISW-stack/index.sqlite3"
MD_PATH = ROOT / "chat/AISW-stack/README.md"
TEMPLATES_DIR = ROOT / "chat/AISW-stack/templates"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# slug + vendor helpers

_PUNCT_RE = re.compile(r"[\s/（）()，,、；;:：&+]+")
_SLUG_DECO_RE = re.compile(r"[*_`\"'·]")

KNOWN_VENDORS = {
    "NVIDIA", "AMD", "Intel", "Apple", "AWS", "Google", "Microsoft", "Meta",
    "Anthropic", "OpenAI", "xAI", "DeepSeek", "Mistral", "Cohere",
    "Databricks", "Snowflake", "Cloudflare", "HuggingFace", "Hugging Face",
    "IBM", "Oracle", "SAP", "Salesforce", "ServiceNow", "Workday",
    "华为", "华为昇腾", "阿里", "百度", "腾讯", "字节",
    "高通", "Qualcomm", "联发科", "MediaTek", "瑞芯微", "Rockchip",
}
VENDOR_ALIASES = {
    "华为昇腾": "华为", "华为昇腾（Ascend）": "华为",
    "Hugging Face": "HuggingFace", "Qualcomm": "高通",
    "MediaTek": "联发科", "Rockchip": "瑞芯微",
}


def canonical_vendor(label: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not label:
        return None
    plain = label.strip()
    bare = re.sub(r"（[^）]*）|\([^)]*\)", "", plain).strip()
    for cand in (plain, bare):
        if cand in VENDOR_ALIASES:
            return VENDOR_ALIASES[cand]
        if cand in KNOWN_VENDORS:
            return cand
    return None


def slugify(prefix: str, name: str) -> str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", name)
    s = _SLUG_DECO_RE.sub("", s)
    s = _PUNCT_RE.sub("-", s)
    s = re.sub(r"-+", "-", s).strip("-").lower()
    if not s:
        s = hashlib.md5(name.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
    return f"{prefix.lower()}-{s}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# data structures used by the renderer

@dataclass
class EntryRow:
    slug: str
    name: str
    url: str | None
    notes: str | None
    ref_num: int | None
    vendor: str | None
    bullet_position: int | None
    bullet_sub_label: str | None


@dataclass
class GroupView:
    position: int
    label_display: str | None
    layout: str
    separator: str | None
    entries: list[EntryRow]

    @property
    def bullets(self) -> list[list[EntryRow]]:
        """For bullets layout, group entries by bullet_position."""
        by_b: dict[int | None, list[EntryRow]] = {}
        order: list[int | None] = []
        for e in self.entries:
            if e.bullet_position not in by_b:
                by_b[e.bullet_position] = []
                order.append(e.bullet_position)
            by_b[e.bullet_position].append(e)
        return [by_b[b] for b in order]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# db connection + section ordering metadata

DOCUMENT_ORDER = [
    ("doc_top",       "top",            None),
    ("summary_table", "summary-table",  "## L 层 × 分支 总表"),
    ("main_overview", "main-overview",  "## A. LLM / Agent — 全栈总览（34 层）"),
    # layers L01..L38 inserted dynamically
    ("branch_intro",  "parallel-intro", "## 各领域分支细节（B–J，共享 L01–L09，从 L10 起分叉）"),
    # branches + subbranches inserted dynamically
    ("crosscut",      "crosscut",       "## 几条横切的观察"),
    ("refs",          "refs",           "## 参考文献"),
]


def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        sys.exit(f"db not found: {DB_PATH}; run `init`.")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# data loading + organization

def load_layers(conn) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT code, position, name FROM layers ORDER BY position"
    ).fetchall()


def load_branches(conn) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT code, parent_code, position, name FROM branches "
        "ORDER BY parent_code IS NOT NULL, position"
    ).fetchall()


def load_refs(conn) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs ORDER BY num"
    ).fetchall()


def load_cells(conn) -> dict[tuple[str, str], str]:
    return {
        (r["layer_code"], r["branch_code"]): r["text"] or ""
        for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT layer_code, branch_code, text FROM cells"
        ).fetchall()
    }


def load_entries_grouped(conn) -> dict[str, list[GroupView]]:
    """Return {section_key: [GroupView, ...]} ordered by group_position then
    entry position."""
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT slug, name, url, notes, vendor, section_key, "
        "       group_position, group_label_display, group_layout, "
        "       group_separator, bullet_position, bullet_sub_label, position "
        "FROM entries "
        "ORDER BY section_key, "
        "         COALESCE(group_position, 999), "
        "         COALESCE(bullet_position, 999), position"
    ).fetchall()
    # also load ref_nums
    ref_map: dict[str, int] = {}
    for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT e.slug, er.ref_num FROM entries e "
        "JOIN entry_refs er ON e.id=er.entry_id "
        "ORDER BY e.id, er.position"
    ).fetchall():
        ref_map.setdefault(r["slug"], r["ref_num"])
    by_section: dict[str, dict[int, GroupView]] = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in rows:
        sec = r["section_key"]
        gpos = r["group_position"] if r["group_position"] is not None else 0
        gv = by_section[sec].get(gpos)
        if gv is None:
            gv = GroupView(
                position=gpos,
                label_display=r["group_label_display"],
                layout=r["group_layout"] or "bullets",
                separator=r["group_separator"],
                entries=[],
            )
            by_section[sec][gpos] = gv
        gv.entries.append(EntryRow(
            slug=r["slug"], name=r["name"], url=r["url"], notes=r["notes"],
            ref_num=ref_map.get(r["slug"]), vendor=r["vendor"],
            bullet_position=r["bullet_position"],
            bullet_sub_label=r["bullet_sub_label"],
        ))
    return {sec: [gv for _, gv in sorted(gvs.items())]
            for sec, gvs in by_section.items()}


def load_prose() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Read all templates/prose/*.md into a dict keyed by section_key."""
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    prose_dir = TEMPLATES_DIR / "prose"
    if not prose_dir.exists():
        return out
    for p in prose_dir.glob("*.md"):
        out[p.stem] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip("\n")
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Jinja2 render

def render_markdown(conn) -> str:
    try:
        import jinja2
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        sys.exit("jinja2 not installed. Run: .venv/bin/pip install jinja2")

    layers = [dict(r) for r in load_layers(conn)]
    branches_all = [dict(r) for r in load_branches(conn)]
    main_branches = [b for b in branches_all if b["parent_code"] is None]
    sub_branches = [b for b in branches_all if b["parent_code"] is not None]
    refs = [dict(r) for r in load_refs(conn)]
    cells = load_cells(conn)
    entries = load_entries_grouped(conn)
    prose = load_prose()

    env = jinja2.Environment(
        loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)),
        keep_trailing_newline=False,
        trim_blocks=False,
        lstrip_blocks=False,
    )
    env.globals["cells"] = cells
    template = env.get_template("readme.md.j2")
    md = template.render(
        layers=layers,
        branches=main_branches,
        sub_branches=sub_branches,
        entries=entries,
        refs=refs,
        cells=cells,
        prose=prose,
    )
    return md.rstrip() + "\n"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI: read

def cmd_render(args):
    conn = connect()
    md = render_markdown(conn)
    MD_PATH.write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"rendered → {MD_PATH}  ({len(md):,} chars)")


def cmd_stats(args):
    conn = connect()
    for table in ("layers", "branches", "entries", "entry_refs", "refs",
                  "cells", "prose_blocks"):
        try:
            n = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
        except sqlite3.OperationalError:
            n = "(none)"
        print(f"{table:14s} {n}")


def cmd_query(args):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(args.sql).fetchall()
    except sqlite3.Error as e:
        sys.exit(f"sql error: {e}")
    if not rows:
        print("(no rows)"); return
    cols = rows[0].keys()
    print("\t".join(cols))
    for r in rows:
        print("\t".join("" if r[c] is None else str(r[c]) for c in cols))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI: entry

def cmd_entry_list(args):
    conn = connect()
    sql = ("SELECT slug, section_key, group_position, vendor, name, url "
           "FROM entries WHERE 1=1")
    params: list = []
    if args.owner:
        sql += " AND section_key=?"; params.append(args.owner)
    if args.vendor:
        sql += " AND vendor=?"; params.append(args.vendor)
    if args.group is not None:
        sql += " AND group_position=?"; params.append(args.group)
    sql += " ORDER BY section_key, group_position, bullet_position, position"
    for r in conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall():
        print(f"{r['slug']:40s} {r['section_key']:8s} g{r['group_position']}  "
              f"{r['vendor'] or '':12s}  {r['name']}  {r['url'] or ''}")


def cmd_entry_show(args):
    conn = connect()
    r = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM entries WHERE slug=?", (args.slug,)
    ).fetchone()
    if not r:
        sys.exit(f"entry slug='{args.slug}' not found")
    for k in r.keys():
        print(f"{k:22s} {r[k]}")
    rn = conn.execute(
        "SELECT ref_num FROM entry_refs WHERE entry_id=? ORDER BY position",
        (r["id"],),
    ).fetchall()
    print(f"{'refs':22s} {[x[0] for x in rn]}")


def cmd_entry_set_url(args):
    conn = connect()
    cur = conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET url=? WHERE slug=?",
                       (args.url, args.slug))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"entry '{args.slug}' not found")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"set url of '{args.slug}' → {args.url}")


def cmd_entry_set_name(args):
    conn = connect()
    cur = conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET name=? WHERE slug=?",
                       (args.name, args.slug))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"entry '{args.slug}' not found")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"set name of '{args.slug}' → {args.name!r}")


def cmd_entry_set_notes(args):
    conn = connect()
    cur = conn.execute("UPDATE entries SET notes=? WHERE slug=?",
                       (args.notes, args.slug))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"entry '{args.slug}' not found")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"set notes of '{args.slug}' → {args.notes!r}")


def cmd_entry_add(args):
    conn = connect()
    owner = args.owner
    # resolve target group_position by label, or create new group at end
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT MAX(group_position) AS g, MAX(position) AS p "
        "FROM entries WHERE section_key=?", (owner,)
    ).fetchone()
    base_pos = (row["p"] or -1) + 1 if row else 0
    if args.group_label:
        existing = conn.execute(
            "SELECT group_position FROM entries WHERE section_key=? "
            "AND group_label_display=? LIMIT 1",
            (owner, args.group_label),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing:
            gpos = existing["group_position"]
        else:
            gpos = (row["g"] or -1) + 1 if row else 0
    elif args.group is not None:
        gpos = args.group
    else:
        gpos = (row["g"] or -1) + 1 if row else 0

    # figure out bullet_position within group
    bp_row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT MAX(bullet_position) AS b FROM entries "
        "WHERE section_key=? AND group_position=?",
        (owner, gpos),
    ).fetchone()
    bullet_pos = (bp_row["b"] or -1) + 1 if (bp_row and bp_row["b"] is not None) else 0

    # canonical vendor
    vendor = canonical_vendor(args.group_label or args.bullet_sub_label)

    slug_base = slugify(owner, args.name)
    slug = slug_base
    n = 2
    while conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM entries WHERE slug=?", (slug,)).fetchone():
        slug = f"{slug_base}-{n}"; n += 1

    layer_code = owner if owner.startswith("L") else None
    branch_code = owner if not owner.startswith("L") else None

    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO entries(slug, name, url, notes, section_key, layer_code, "
        "branch_code, vendor, category, position, group_position, "
        "group_label_display, group_layout, group_separator, "
        "bullet_position, bullet_sub_label) VALUES "
        "(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (slug, args.name, args.url, args.notes, owner,
         layer_code, branch_code,
         vendor, args.group_label if not vendor else None,
         base_pos, gpos, args.group_label, args.layout or "bullets",
         args.separator, bullet_pos, args.bullet_sub_label),
    )
    eid = cur.lastrowid
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO entry_refs(entry_id, ref_num, position) VALUES (?, ?, 0)",
        (eid, args.ref),
    )
    conn.commit()
    print(f"added entry slug={slug}  (gpos={gpos}, bullet={bullet_pos})")


def cmd_entry_remove(args):
    conn = connect()
    cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM entries WHERE slug=?", (args.slug,))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"entry '{args.slug}' not found")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"removed entry '{args.slug}'")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI: group

def cmd_group_list(args):
    conn = connect()
    sql = ("SELECT section_key, group_position, group_label_display, "
           "       group_layout, group_separator, COUNT(*) AS n "
           "FROM entries WHERE 1=1")
    params: list = []
    if args.owner:
        sql += " AND section_key=?"; params.append(args.owner)
    sql += " GROUP BY section_key, group_position " \
           "ORDER BY section_key, group_position"
    for r in conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall():
        print(f"{r['section_key']:8s} g{r['group_position']}  "
              f"layout={r['group_layout']}  "
              f"label={r['group_label_display']!r:30s}  n={r['n']}")


def cmd_group_set_label(args):
    conn = connect()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE entries SET group_label_display=? WHERE section_key=? AND "
        "group_position=?",
        (args.label, args.owner, args.gpos),
    )
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"no entries match owner={args.owner} gpos={args.gpos}")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"updated {cur.rowcount} rows: label → {args.label!r}")


def cmd_group_set_layout(args):
    conn = connect()
    cur = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE entries SET group_layout=?, group_separator=? "
        "WHERE section_key=? AND group_position=?",
        (args.layout, args.separator, args.owner, args.gpos),
    )
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"no entries match owner={args.owner} gpos={args.gpos}")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"updated {cur.rowcount} rows: layout → {args.layout}")


def cmd_group_renumber(args):
    conn = connect()
    # find unique gpos values in order
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT DISTINCT group_position FROM entries WHERE section_key=? "
        "ORDER BY group_position", (args.owner,)
    ).fetchall()
    for new_g, r in enumerate(rows):
        old_g = r["group_position"]
        if old_g == new_g:
            continue
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE entries SET group_position=? WHERE section_key=? AND "
            "group_position=?", (new_g, args.owner, old_g),
        )
    conn.commit()
    print(f"renumbered {len(rows)} groups in '{args.owner}'")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI: ref

def cmd_ref_list(args):
    conn = connect()
    if args.orphan:
        rows = conn.execute("""
            SELECT r.num, r.url FROM refs r
            LEFT JOIN entry_refs er ON r.num = er.ref_num
            WHERE er.entry_id IS NULL ORDER BY r.num
        """).fetchall()
    else:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT num, url, citation FROM refs ORDER BY num"
        ).fetchall()
    for r in rows:
        print("\t".join("" if r[c] is None else str(r[c]) for c in r.keys()))


def cmd_ref_show(args):
    conn = connect()
    r = conn.execute(
        "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs WHERE num=?", (args.num,)
    ).fetchone()
    if not r:
        sys.exit(f"ref [{args.num}] not found")
    if r["url"]:
        print(f"[{r['num']}] {r['citation']} [Online]. Available: <{r['url']}>")
    else:
        print(f"[{r['num']}] {r['citation']}")


def cmd_ref_add(args):
    conn = connect()
    citation = re.sub(
        r"\s*\[Online\]\.\s+Available:\s*<[^>]+>\s*$", "", args.citation
    ).strip()
    if args.url:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT num FROM refs WHERE url=?",
                           (args.url,)).fetchone()
        if row:
            print(row[0]); return
    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(num),0) FROM refs").fetchone()
    num = row[0] + 1
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO refs(num, citation, url) VALUES(?, ?, ?)",
        (num, citation, args.url),
    )
    conn.commit()
    print(num)


def cmd_ref_set(args):
    conn = connect()
    fields, vals = [], []
    if args.citation is not None:
        c = re.sub(r"\s*\[Online\]\.\s+Available:\s*<[^>]+>\s*$",
                   "", args.citation).strip()
        fields.append("citation=?"); vals.append(c)
    if args.url is not None:
        fields.append("url=?"); vals.append(args.url)
    if not fields:
        sys.exit("nothing to set")
    vals.append(args.num)
    cur = conn.execute(f"UPDATE refs SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE num=?", vals)
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"ref [{args.num}] not found")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"updated ref [{args.num}]")


def cmd_ref_remove(args):
    conn = connect()
    cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM refs WHERE num=?", (args.num,))
    if cur.rowcount == 0:
        sys.exit(f"ref [{args.num}] not found")
    conn.commit()
    print(f"removed ref [{args.num}]")


def cmd_ref_next(args):
    conn = connect()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(num),0)+1 FROM refs").fetchone()
    print(row[0])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI: cell

def cmd_cell_get(args):
    conn = connect()
    r = conn.execute(
        "SELECT text FROM cells WHERE layer_code=? AND branch_code=?",
        (args.layer, args.branch),
    ).fetchone()
    print(r["text"] if r else "(empty)")


def cmd_cell_set(args):
    conn = connect()
    marker = _classify_cell(args.text)
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cells(layer_code, branch_code, text, marker) "
        "VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (args.layer, args.branch, args.text, marker),
    )
    conn.commit()
    print(f"set cell ({args.layer}, {args.branch})")


def _classify_cell(t: str | None) -> str:
    t = (t or "").strip()
    if not t or t in ("—", "-", "–"):
        return "none"
    if t.startswith("同 A"):
        return "same_a"
    if t.startswith("与 ") and "共用" in t:
        return "shared"
    return "normal"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# argparse

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    sub.add_parser("render").set_defaults(func=cmd_render)
    sub.add_parser("stats").set_defaults(func=cmd_stats)
    pq = sub.add_parser("query"); pq.add_argument("sql")
    pq.set_defaults(func=cmd_query)

    # entry
    pe = sub.add_parser("entry"); pes = pe.add_subparsers(dest="entry_cmd", required=True)
    pel = pes.add_parser("list"); pel.add_argument("--owner"); pel.add_argument("--vendor")
    pel.add_argument("--group", type=int); pel.set_defaults(func=cmd_entry_list)
    psh = pes.add_parser("show"); psh.add_argument("slug")
    psh.set_defaults(func=cmd_entry_show)
    pa = pes.add_parser("add")
    pa.add_argument("owner")
    pa.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    pa.add_argument("--url", required=True)
    pa.add_argument("--ref", type=int, required=True)
    pa.add_argument("--group-label", dest="group_label")
    pa.add_argument("--group", type=int)
    pa.add_argument("--layout", choices=["bullets", "inline"])
    pa.add_argument("--separator")
    pa.add_argument("--notes")
    pa.add_argument("--bullet-sub-label", dest="bullet_sub_label")
    pa.set_defaults(func=cmd_entry_add)
    pu = pes.add_parser("set-url"); pu.add_argument("slug"); pu.add_argument("--url", required=True)
    pu.set_defaults(func=cmd_entry_set_url)
    pn = pes.add_parser("set-name"); pn.add_argument("slug"); pn.add_argument("--name", required=True)
    pn.set_defaults(func=cmd_entry_set_name)
    pt = pes.add_parser("set-notes"); pt.add_argument("slug"); pt.add_argument("--notes")
    pt.set_defaults(func=cmd_entry_set_notes)
    pr = pes.add_parser("remove"); pr.add_argument("slug")
    pr.set_defaults(func=cmd_entry_remove)

    # group
    pg = sub.add_parser("group"); pgs = pg.add_subparsers(dest="group_cmd", required=True)
    pgl = pgs.add_parser("list"); pgl.add_argument("--owner")
    pgl.set_defaults(func=cmd_group_list)
    pgsl = pgs.add_parser("set-label"); pgsl.add_argument("owner")
    pgsl.add_argument("--gpos", type=int, required=True)
    pgsl.add_argument("--label", required=True)
    pgsl.set_defaults(func=cmd_group_set_label)
    pgsy = pgs.add_parser("set-layout"); pgsy.add_argument("owner")
    pgsy.add_argument("--gpos", type=int, required=True)
    pgsy.add_argument("--layout", choices=["bullets", "inline"], required=True)
    pgsy.add_argument("--separator")
    pgsy.set_defaults(func=cmd_group_set_layout)
    pgr = pgs.add_parser("renumber"); pgr.add_argument("owner")
    pgr.set_defaults(func=cmd_group_renumber)

    # ref
    prf = sub.add_parser("ref"); prs = prf.add_subparsers(dest="ref_cmd", required=True)
    prl = prs.add_parser("list"); prl.add_argument("--orphan", action="store_true")
    prl.set_defaults(func=cmd_ref_list)
    prsh = prs.add_parser("show"); prsh.add_argument("num", type=int)
    prsh.set_defaults(func=cmd_ref_show)
    pra = prs.add_parser("add"); pra.add_argument("--citation", required=True)
    pra.add_argument("--url"); pra.set_defaults(func=cmd_ref_add)
    prset = prs.add_parser("set"); prset.add_argument("num", type=int)
    prset.add_argument("--citation"); prset.add_argument("--url")
    prset.set_defaults(func=cmd_ref_set)
    prrm = prs.add_parser("remove"); prrm.add_argument("num", type=int)
    prrm.set_defaults(func=cmd_ref_remove)
    prs.add_parser("next-num").set_defaults(func=cmd_ref_next)

    # cell
    pc = sub.add_parser("cell"); pcs = pc.add_subparsers(dest="cell_cmd", required=True)
    pcg = pcs.add_parser("get"); pcg.add_argument("layer"); pcg.add_argument("branch")
    pcg.set_defaults(func=cmd_cell_get)
    pcset = pcs.add_parser("set"); pcset.add_argument("layer"); pcset.add_argument("branch")
    pcset.add_argument("--text", required=True); pcset.set_defaults(func=cmd_cell_set)

    args = p.parse_args()
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""AISW-stack MVC Controller —— Jinja2 视图版本。

架构：
  Model       chat/AISW-stack/index.sqlite3
                结构化数据 (source of truth)：
                  layers       (code, position, name)
                  branches     (code, parent_code, position, name)
                  entries      (slug, name, url, notes, ref_num, vendor,
                                section_key, group_position,
                                group_label_display, group_layout,
                                group_separator, bullet_position,
                                bullet_sub_label, position)
                  refs         (num, citation, url)
                  cells        (layer_code, branch_code, text)
                  prose_blocks (section_key, kind, body) — staging only
  Template    chat/AISW-stack/templates/
                readme.md.j2    主模版
                _macros.j2      渲染宏（entry / group / summary table / refs）
                prose/<key>.md  每个 section 的散文（用户手工编辑这些文件改散文）
  Controller  scripts/aiswstack_controller.py（本文件）
                render() = Jinja2 加载模板 → 注入 db 数据 → 写 README.md

## CLI

  init                          建空 schema（重置 db）
  render                        Jinja2 渲染 → 写 README.md
  stats
  query SQL                     只读 SELECT

  entry list [--owner CODE] [--vendor V] [--group GPOS]
  entry show SLUG
  entry add OWNER --name N --url U --ref R --group-label LBL
            [--layout bullets|inline] [--separator SEP] [--notes T]
            [--bullet-sub-label SL]
  entry set-url SLUG --url U
  entry set-name SLUG --name N
  entry set-notes SLUG --notes T
  entry remove SLUG

  group list [--owner CODE]
  group set-label OWNER --gpos N --label LBL
  group set-layout OWNER --gpos N --layout L [--separator SEP]
  group renumber OWNER          压缩 group_position 间隙

  ref list [--orphan]
  ref show NUM
  ref add --citation T [--url U]
  ref set NUM [--citation T] [--url U]
  ref remove NUM
  ref next-num

  cell get LAYER BRANCH
  cell set LAYER BRANCH --text T

## 设计要点

1. 模型只存数据。每条 entry 行带其分组与排版元数据（denormalized），
   render 时按 (section_key, group_position) 聚合、按 bullet_position 切分。
2. 散文（每层 intro / 分支 overview / crosscut / preamble）作为 Jinja2 文件
   存在 templates/prose/，用户直接编辑这些 .md 文件。
3. render 只读数据 + 模板，不写库；mutation 命令只写库，不写模板。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import re
import sqlite3
import sys
import unicodedata
from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DB_PATH = ROOT / "chat/AISW-stack/index.sqlite3"
MD_PATH = ROOT / "chat/AISW-stack/README.md"
TEMPLATES_DIR = ROOT / "chat/AISW-stack/templates"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# slug + vendor helpers

_PUNCT_RE = re.compile(r"[\s/（）()，,、；;:：&+]+")
_SLUG_DECO_RE = re.compile(r"[*_`\"'·]")

KNOWN_VENDORS = {
    "NVIDIA", "AMD", "Intel", "Apple", "AWS", "Google", "Microsoft", "Meta",
    "Anthropic", "OpenAI", "xAI", "DeepSeek", "Mistral", "Cohere",
    "Databricks", "Snowflake", "Cloudflare", "HuggingFace", "Hugging Face",
    "IBM", "Oracle", "SAP", "Salesforce", "ServiceNow", "Workday",
    "华为", "华为昇腾", "阿里", "百度", "腾讯", "字节",
    "高通", "Qualcomm", "联发科", "MediaTek", "瑞芯微", "Rockchip",
}
VENDOR_ALIASES = {
    "华为昇腾": "华为", "华为昇腾（Ascend）": "华为",
    "Hugging Face": "HuggingFace", "Qualcomm": "高通",
    "MediaTek": "联发科", "Rockchip": "瑞芯微",
}


def canonical_vendor(label: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not label:
        return None
    plain = label.strip()
    bare = re.sub(r"（[^）]*）|\([^)]*\)", "", plain).strip()
    for cand in (plain, bare):
        if cand in VENDOR_ALIASES:
            return VENDOR_ALIASES[cand]
        if cand in KNOWN_VENDORS:
            return cand
    return None


def slugify(prefix: str, name: str) -> str:
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", name)
    s = _SLUG_DECO_RE.sub("", s)
    s = _PUNCT_RE.sub("-", s)
    s = re.sub(r"-+", "-", s).strip("-").lower()
    if not s:
        s = hashlib.md5(name.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
    return f"{prefix.lower()}-{s}"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# data structures used by the renderer

@dataclass
class EntryRow:
    slug: str
    name: str
    url: str | None
    notes: str | None
    ref_num: int | None
    vendor: str | None
    bullet_position: int | None
    bullet_sub_label: str | None


@dataclass
class GroupView:
    position: int
    label_display: str | None
    layout: str
    separator: str | None
    entries: list[EntryRow]

    @property
    def bullets(self) -> list[list[EntryRow]]:
        """For bullets layout, group entries by bullet_position."""
        by_b: dict[int | None, list[EntryRow]] = {}
        order: list[int | None] = []
        for e in self.entries:
            if e.bullet_position not in by_b:
                by_b[e.bullet_position] = []
                order.append(e.bullet_position)
            by_b[e.bullet_position].append(e)
        return [by_b[b] for b in order]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# db connection + section ordering metadata

DOCUMENT_ORDER = [
    ("doc_top",       "top",            None),
    ("summary_table", "summary-table",  "## L 层 × 分支 总表"),
    ("main_overview", "main-overview",  "## A. LLM / Agent — 全栈总览（34 层）"),
    # layers L01..L38 inserted dynamically
    ("branch_intro",  "parallel-intro", "## 各领域分支细节（B–J，共享 L01–L09，从 L10 起分叉）"),
    # branches + subbranches inserted dynamically
    ("crosscut",      "crosscut",       "## 几条横切的观察"),
    ("refs",          "refs",           "## 参考文献"),
]


def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        sys.exit(f"db not found: {DB_PATH}; run `init`.")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    return conn


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# data loading + organization

def load_layers(conn) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT code, position, name FROM layers ORDER BY position"
    ).fetchall()


def load_branches(conn) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT code, parent_code, position, name FROM branches "
        "ORDER BY parent_code IS NOT NULL, position"
    ).fetchall()


def load_refs(conn) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT num, citation, url FROM refs ORDER BY num"
    ).fetchall()


def load_cells(conn) -> dict[tuple[str, str], str]:
    return {
        (r["layer_code"], r["branch_code"]): r["text"] or ""
        for r in conn.execute(
            "SELECT layer_code, branch_code, text FROM cells"
        ).fetchall()
    }


def load_entries_grouped(conn) -> dict[str, list[GroupView]]:
    """Return {section_key: [GroupView, ...]} ordered by group_position then
    entry position."""
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT slug, name, url, notes, vendor, section_key, "
        "       group_position, group_label_display, group_layout, "
        "       group_separator, bullet_position, bullet_sub_label, position "
        "FROM entries "
        "ORDER BY section_key, "
        "         COALESCE(group_position, 999), "
        "         COALESCE(bullet_position, 999), position"
    ).fetchall()
    # also load ref_nums
    ref_map: dict[str, int] = {}
    for r in conn.execute(
        "SELECT e.slug, er.ref_num FROM entries e "
        "JOIN entry_refs er ON e.id=er.entry_id "
        "ORDER BY e.id, er.position"
    ).fetchall():
        ref_map.setdefault(r["slug"], r["ref_num"])
    by_section: dict[str, dict[int, GroupView]] = defaultdict(dict)
    for r in rows:
        sec = r["section_key"]
        gpos = r["group_position"] if r["group_position"] is not None else 0
        gv = by_section[sec].get(gpos)
        if gv is None:
            gv = GroupView(
                position=gpos,
                label_display=r["group_label_display"],
                layout=r["group_layout"] or "bullets",
                separator=r["group_separator"],
                entries=[],
            )
            by_section[sec][gpos] = gv
        gv.entries.append(EntryRow(
            slug=r["slug"], name=r["name"], url=r["url"], notes=r["notes"],
            ref_num=ref_map.get(r["slug"]), vendor=r["vendor"],
            bullet_position=r["bullet_position"],
            bullet_sub_label=r["bullet_sub_label"],
        ))
    return {sec: [gv for _, gv in sorted(gvs.items())]
            for sec, gvs in by_section.items()}


def load_prose() -> dict[str, str]:
    """Read all templates/prose/*.md into a dict keyed by section_key."""
    out: dict[str, str] = {}
    prose_dir = TEMPLATES_DIR / "prose"
    if not prose_dir.exists():
        return out
    for p in prose_dir.glob("*.md"):
        out[p.stem] = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").rstrip("\n")
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Jinja2 render

def render_markdown(conn) -> str:
    try:
        import jinja2
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        sys.exit("jinja2 not installed. Run: .venv/bin/pip install jinja2")

    layers = [dict(r) for r in load_layers(conn)]
    branches_all = [dict(r) for r in load_branches(conn)]
    main_branches = [b for b in branches_all if b["parent_code"] is None]
    sub_branches = [b for b in branches_all if b["parent_code"] is not None]
    refs = [dict(r) for r in load_refs(conn)]
    cells = load_cells(conn)
    entries = load_entries_grouped(conn)
    prose = load_prose()

    env = jinja2.Environment(
        loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)),
        keep_trailing_newline=False,
        trim_blocks=False,
        lstrip_blocks=False,
    )
    env.globals["cells"] = cells
    template = env.get_template("readme.md.j2")
    md = template.render(
        layers=layers,
        branches=main_branches,
        sub_branches=sub_branches,
        entries=entries,
        refs=refs,
        cells=cells,
        prose=prose,
    )
    return md.rstrip() + "\n"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI: read

def cmd_render(args):
    conn = connect()
    md = render_markdown(conn)
    MD_PATH.write_text(md, encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"rendered → {MD_PATH}  ({len(md):,} chars)")


def cmd_stats(args):
    conn = connect()
    for table in ("layers", "branches", "entries", "entry_refs", "refs",
                  "cells", "prose_blocks"):
        try:
            n = conn.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table}").fetchone()[0]
        except sqlite3.OperationalError:
            n = "(none)"
        print(f"{table:14s} {n}")


def cmd_query(args):
    conn = connect()
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(args.sql).fetchall()
    except sqlite3.Error as e:
        sys.exit(f"sql error: {e}")
    if not rows:
        print("(no rows)"); return
    cols = rows[0].keys()
    print("\t".join(cols))
    for r in rows:
        print("\t".join("" if r[c] is None else str(r[c]) for c in cols))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CLI: entry

def cmd_entry_list(args):
    conn = connect()
    sql = ("SELECT slug, section_key, group_position, vendor, name, url "
           "FROM entries WHERE 1=1")
    params: list = []
    if args.owner:
        sql += " AND section_key=?"; params.append(args.owner)
    if args.vendor:
        sql += " AND vendor=?"; params.append(args.vendor)
    if args.group is not None:
        sql += " AND group_position=?"; params.append(args.group)
    sql += " ORDER BY section_key, group_position, bullet_position, position"
    for r in conn.execute(sql, params).fetchall():
        print(f"{r['slug']:40s} {r['section_key']:8s} g{r['group_position']}  "
              f"{r['vendor'] or '':12s}  {r['name']}  {r['url'] or ''}")


def cmd_entry_show(args):
    conn = connect()
    r = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM entries WHERE slug=?", (args.slug,)
    ).fetchone()
    if not r:
        sys.exit(f"entry slug='{args.slug}' not found")
    for k in r.keys():
        print(f"{k:22s} {r[k]}")
    rn = conn.execute(
        "SELECT ref_num FROM entry_refs WHERE entry_id=? ORDER BY position",

def cmd_entry_add(args):
    conn = connect()
    owner = args.owner
    # resolve target group_position by label, or create new group at end
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT MAX(group_position) AS g, MAX(position) AS p "
        "FROM entries WHERE section_key=?", (owner,)
    ).fetchone()
    base_pos = (row["p"] or -1) + 1 if row else 0
    if args.group_label:
        existing = conn.execute(
            "SELECT group_position FROM entries WHERE section_key=? "
            "AND group_label_display=? LIMIT 1",
            (owner, args.group_label),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing:
            gpos = existing["group_position"]
        else:
            gpos = (row["g"] or -1) + 1 if row else 0
    elif args.group is not None:
        gpos = args.group
    else:
        gpos = (row["g"] or -1) + 1 if row else 0

    # figure out bullet_position within group
    bp_row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT MAX(bullet_position) AS b FROM entries "
        "WHERE section_key=? AND group_position=?",
        (owner, gpos),
    ).fetchone()
    bullet_pos = (bp_row["b"] or -1) + 1 if (bp_row and bp_row["b"] is not None) else 0

    # canonical vendor
    vendor = canonical_vendor(args.group_label or args.bullet_sub_label)

    slug_base = slugify(owner, args.name)
    slug = slug_base
    n = 2
    while conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM entries WHERE slug=?", (slug,)).fetchone():
        slug = f"{slug_base}-{n}"; n += 1

    layer_code = owner if owner.startswith("L") else None
    branch_code = owner if not owner.startswith("L") else None

    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO entries(slug, name, url, notes, section_key, layer_code, "
        "branch_code, vendor, category, position, group_position, "
        "group_label_display, group_layout, group_separator, "
        "bullet_position, bullet_sub_label) VALUES "
        "(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (slug, args.name, args.url, args.notes, owner,
         layer_code, branch_code,
         vendor, args.group_label if not vendor else None,
         base_pos, gpos, args.group_label, args.layout or "bullets",
         args.separator, bullet_pos, args.bullet_sub_label),
    )
    eid = cur.lastrowid
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO entry_refs(entry_id, ref_num, position) VALUES (?, ?, 0)",
        (eid, args.ref),
    )
    conn.commit()
    print(f"added entry slug={slug}  (gpos={gpos}, bullet={bullet_pos})")

def cmd_group_renumber(args):
    conn = connect()
    # find unique gpos values in order
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT DISTINCT group_position FROM entries WHERE section_key=? "
        "ORDER BY group_position", (args.owner,)
    ).fetchall()
    for new_g, r in enumerate(rows):
        old_g = r["group_position"]
        if old_g == new_g:
            continue
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE entries SET group_position=? WHERE section_key=? AND "
            "group_position=?", (new_g, args.owner, old_g),
        )
    conn.commit()
    print(f"renumbered {len(rows)} groups in '{args.owner}'")

def _classify_cell(t: str | None) -> str:
    t = (t or "").strip()
    if not t or t in ("—", "-", "–"):
        return "none"
    if t.startswith("同 A"):
        return "same_a"
    if t.startswith("与 ") and "共用" in t:
        return "shared"
    return "normal"

content.subject: 实现新 schema + entry_groups 表
content.description: 扩展 sqlite3 schema：新增 entry_groups(id, section_key, position, label, vendor, layout, separator)；entries 表新增 group_id 列，group_id 替代 layer/branch + vendor 的隐式分组。

content.subject: 写迁移脚本：从 sections.body 抽出 groups + entries 到结构表，把散文写入模板文件
content.description: 一次性脚本：(1) 解析每个 layer/subbranch 的 body，识别 vendor block / category block / inline list，生成 entry_groups 行并把 entries 关联到 group_id；(2) 抽出每个 section 的纯散文（intro/outro/branch overview/crosscut/top/main-overview/parallel-intro）写入对应 templates/*.j2 文件。

content.subject: 实现 Jinja2 渲染器替换 render()
content.description: 改 render 命令：用 jinja2.Environment 加载 templates/readme.md.j2，传入 layers/branches/entries/groups/refs/cells 数据，输出 README.md。增加 _macros.j2（render_entry, render_group, render_summary_table, render_refs 等）。

content.subject: 改 Controller CLI：删 section set-body，加 group CRUD，调整 entry add
content.description: entry set-url/name/notes 直接改 entries 表行（不再 body patch）；entry add 接受 --group-id 或 --vb-label（解析到 group_id）；新增 group add/remove/set-label/set-layout；section set-body 退役（散文改模板文件）；refresh-index 退役或改为只重建 derived metadata。

content.subject: 字节级验证 + 更新 SKILL.md
content.description: 新 render 跑出的 README.md 应与原 README.md 字节级 / 接近字节级一致（可接受表头空格规整化等表面差异）。最后大改 SKILL.md：删 body 相关流程，加模板编辑流程 + 新 group/entry CLI 配方。

# AI 软件栈分层索引：从设备驱动到终端用户应用

从最底层的设备驱动 / 固件（GPU、NPU、加速卡），一直到最终用户接触的应用，完整一根栈。每层至少列 3 个代表性软件 / 项目 / 厂商；同层多个候选时尽量覆盖闭源前沿、开源主流、新兴挑战者三类。

总表横轴 10 条领域分支：**A** LLM / Agent、**B** 科学计算 / AI4Science、**C** 机器人、**D** 自动驾驶、**E** 世界模型 / 3D、**F** 经典视觉、**G** 量化金融、**H** 游戏、**I** 影视娱乐、**J** 学习 / 教育。所有分支共享 **L01–L09** 的硬件 / 内核 / 框架底座，从 L10 起在领域模型 / 数据 / 部署 / 终端产品上分叉。本文按两个维度组织：L01–L38 各层段呈现每层在各分支的样态；"各领域分支细节"一章按分支视角展开 L10+ 的子层与终端产品。

## L 层 × 分支 总表

横轴 10 列对应 **A–J 共 10 条领域分支**。纵轴每一行是一个 L 层，每个条目**严格归属**到当行 L，不跨层。规则：

- `同 A`：该层在该分支与 A 列基本沿用同款（驱动 / 内核 / 编译器 / 实验追踪多数如此）。
- `—`：该层在该分支不存在或可忽略。
- **L35–L38** 是 A 没有、仅部分领域分支必需的扩展层；A 列保持空。
  - L35 HPC 作业调度 / 工作流（B 专属：Slurm[[4]](https://slurm.schedmd.com/) / PBS / Spack 这一段在 LLM 训练里被 K8s[[5]](https://kubernetes.io/) + Ray[[6]](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/index.html) 取代）
  - L36 机器人 / 实时中间件（C / D 共用：ROS 2[[7]](https://www.ros.org/) / DriveWorks / AUTOSAR / Holoscan）

content.description:

- sqlite3：layers/branches/refs/cells + entries（扩列 group_position, group_label_display, group_layout, group_separator, bullet_position, bullet_sub_label 表达组结构）
- templates/：readme.md.j2 主模版 + preamble/layers/branches/crosscut/refs partial + _macros.j2

- render 改为 jinja2.Environment(FileSystemLoader)，传 layers/branches/entries/refs/cells 数据

content.subject: 实现新 schema + entry_groups 表
content.description: 扩展 sqlite3 schema：新增 entry_groups(id, section_key, position, label, vendor, layout, separator)；entries 表新增 group_id 列，group_id 替代 layer/branch + vendor 的隐式分组。

content.subject: 写迁移脚本：从 sections.body 抽出 groups + entries 到结构表，把散文写入模板文件
content.description: 迁移完成：85 个 layer/sub section 的 843 个 entries 全部填上 group_position/label_display/layout/separator/bullet_position/bullet_sub_label；55 个散文块（top, main-overview, summary-table intro, parallel-intro, 各 layer/sub intros, crosscut, branch overviews）写入 templates/prose/*.md。脚本 scripts/aiswstack_migrate_to_jinja.py。

content.subject: 实现 Jinja2 渲染器替换 render()
content.description: 改 render 命令：用 jinja2.Environment 加载 templates/readme.md.j2，传入 layers/branches/entries/groups/refs/cells 数据，输出 README.md。增加 _macros.j2（render_entry, render_group, render_summary_table, render_refs 等）。

content.subject: 实现新 schema + entry_groups 表

content.subject: 设计新数据模型 + 模板架构
content.description:
设计已确定：
- sqlite3：layers/branches/refs/cells + entries（扩列 group_position, group_label_display, group_layout, group_separator, bullet_position, bullet_sub_label 表达组结构）
- templates/：readme.md.j2 主模版 + preamble/layers/branches/crosscut/refs partial + _macros.j2
- 散文（所有 L01–L38/B1–J6/branch overview/crosscut/preamble）以 Jinja2 字面文本写在 partial 里
- render 改为 jinja2.Environment(FileSystemLoader)，传 layers/branches/entries/refs/cells 数据

content.subject: 实现新 schema + entry_groups 表
content.description: 扩展 sqlite3 schema：新增 entry_groups(id, section_key, position, label, vendor, layout, separator)；entries 表新增 group_id 列，group_id 替代 layer/branch + vendor 的隐式分组。

content.subject: 写迁移脚本：从 sections.body 抽出 groups + entries 到结构表，把散文写入模板文件
content.description: 迁移完成：85 个 layer/sub section 的 843 个 entries 全部填上 group_position/label_display/layout/separator/bullet_position/bullet_sub_label；55 个散文块（top, main-overview, summary-table intro, parallel-intro, 各 layer/sub intros, crosscut, branch overviews）写入 templates/prose/*.md。脚本 scripts/aiswstack_migrate_to_jinja.py。

content.subject: 实现 Jinja2 渲染器替换 render()
content.description: 改 render 命令：用 jinja2.Environment 加载 templates/readme.md.j2，传入 layers/branches/entries/groups/refs/cells 数据，输出 README.md。增加 _macros.j2（render_entry, render_group, render_summary_table, render_refs 等）。

content.subject: 改 Controller CLI：删 section set-body，加 group CRUD，调整 entry add
content.description: entry set-url/name/notes 直接改 entries 表行（不再 body patch）；entry add 接受 --group-id 或 --vb-label（解析到 group_id）；新增 group add/remove/set-label/set-layout；section set-body 退役（散文改模板文件）；refresh-index 退役或改为只重建 derived metadata。

content.subject: 字节级验证 + 更新 SKILL.md
content.description: 新 render 跑出的 README.md 应与原 README.md 字节级 / 接近字节级一致（可接受表头空格规整化等表面差异）。最后大改 SKILL.md：删 body 相关流程，加模板编辑流程 + 新 group/entry CLI 配方。

content.description:
设计已确定：
- sqlite3：layers/branches/refs/cells + entries（扩列 group_position, group_label_display, group_layout, group_separator, bullet_position, bullet_sub_label 表达组结构）
- templates/：readme.md.j2 主模版 + preamble/layers/branches/crosscut/refs partial + _macros.j2
- 散文（所有 L01–L38/B1–J6/branch overview/crosscut/preamble）以 Jinja2 字面文本写在 partial 里
- render 改为 jinja2.Environment(FileSystemLoader)，传 layers/branches/entries/refs/cells 数据

content.subject: 实现新 schema + entry_groups 表
content.description: 扩展 sqlite3 schema：新增 entry_groups(id, section_key, position, label, vendor, layout, separator)；entries 表新增 group_id 列，group_id 替代 layer/branch + vendor 的隐式分组。

content.subject: 写迁移脚本：从 sections.body 抽出 groups + entries 到结构表，把散文写入模板文件
content.description: 迁移完成：85 个 layer/sub section 的 843 个 entries 全部填上 group_position/label_display/layout/separator/bullet_position/bullet_sub_label；55 个散文块（top, main-overview, summary-table intro, parallel-intro, 各 layer/sub intros, crosscut, branch overviews）写入 templates/prose/*.md。脚本 scripts/aiswstack_migrate_to_jinja.py。

content.subject: 实现 Jinja2 渲染器替换 render()
content.description: 改 render 命令：用 jinja2.Environment 加载 templates/readme.md.j2，传入 layers/branches/entries/groups/refs/cells 数据，输出 README.md。增加 _macros.j2（render_entry, render_group, render_summary_table, render_refs 等）。

content.subject: 改 Controller CLI：删 section set-body，加 group CRUD，调整 entry add
content.description: entry set-url/name/notes 直接改 entries 表行（不再 body patch）；entry add 接受 --group-id 或 --vb-label（解析到 group_id）；新增 group add/remove/set-label/set-layout；section set-body 退役（散文改模板文件）；refresh-index 退役或改为只重建 derived metadata。
